scope_findings.claim: FIELDWISE is an MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowship (MSCA-PF), European Fellowship variant, with a 24-month standard duration — consistent with the 12-to-24-month window — plus an optional 6-month non-academic sector placement at AgroVIR at the end of the project (total 30 months).
The host institution is Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE), Hungary — an EU Member State and therefore an admissible host for a European Postdoctoral Fellowship.

A 6-month non-academic sector placement at AgroVIR is included at the end of the project and is explicitly framed as an integral part of the proposal, with justified added value for both the project (research-to-commercial-field operational bridge) and the researcher's career development.

FIELDWISE includes cross-country scientific engagement with MVCRI (Maritsa Vegetable Crops Research Institute) in Bulgaria for geographic transferability testing of the predictive model. The structural characterisation of this engagement — whether it constitutes a formal secondment involving physical researcher relocation or a remote data-collaboration and field-sampling arrangement — is not specified in the concept note or strategic positioning.
scope_findings.flag_reason: SR-07 (mandatory: false, conditional_requirement) and CC-07 impose duration constraints on secondments within European Fellowships: secondments cannot exceed half the requested fellowship duration (i.e., maximum 12 months for a 24-month fellowship), and must add significant value and impact to the fellowship. The concept note positions MVCRI Bulgaria as a cross-country transferability environment but does not specify whether the researcher will physically relocate there as a formal secondment or whether the engagement is conducted through data exchange and remote collaboration. If a formal secondment is intended, its planned duration must be confirmed as within the SR-07 / CC-07 limit before structural compliance can be asserted.

scope_findings.claim: FIELDWISE will use processing tomato as its primary model crop to develop prediction systems for physiological crop water stress, integrating five years of MATE hyperspectral observations, soil-sensor data, field meteorological-station observations, and Sentinel-2A satellite imagery within a unified digital environment.
scope_findings.flag_reason: No Tier 2B scope element found to confirm this research topic and data-integration methodology as in-scope; scope boundary is defined by Tier 2B only. The MSCA-PF scope requirements (SR-01 to SR-08) establish fellowship-structural, eligibility, training, and mobility requirements but impose no thematic research-domain restriction. This claim cannot be confirmed as in-scope from Tier 2B scope_requirements.json or call_constraints.json data alone, consistent with CLAUDE.md §13.2 and §13.9.

scope_findings.claim: FIELDWISE proposes a fundamental methodological shift from retrospective accuracy metrics (R², RMSE, F1-score, classification accuracy) to prospective prediction, temporal transferability, geographic transferability, and Field Decision Value (FDV) as the primary evaluation framework for agricultural machine learning models.
scope_findings.flag_reason: No Tier 2B scope element found to confirm this methodological positioning — EO integration, hyperspectral-to-Sentinel scaling, prospective forecasting, or the FDV metric — as in-scope; scope boundary is defined by Tier 2B only. SR-04 references digital skills as a mandatory training requirement but does not constitute a thematic scope confirmation for EO-based or ML-based research methodologies. This claim cannot be confirmed as in-scope from Tier 2B data alone.

scope_findings.claim: FIELDWISE claims environmental impact through improved irrigation timing contributing to EU-level opportunities for water savings in irrigated agriculture, without asserting a specific percentage reduction in advance.
scope_findings.flag_reason: No Tier 2B scope element found to confirm this environmental impact claim as in-scope; scope boundary is defined by Tier 2B only. The MSCA-PF scope requirements do not specify expected societal, environmental, or agricultural impacts for eligible research. This claim cannot be confirmed as in-scope from Tier 2B data alone.

scope_findings.claim: FIELDWISE claims scientific and European impact by establishing a framework for agricultural AI evaluated on temporal, geographic, and operational transferability — directly addressing the question of whether agricultural intelligence developed in one European environment (Hungary) can be made reliably transferable to another (Bulgaria).
scope_findings.flag_reason: No Tier 2B scope element found to confirm this European scientific impact framing as in-scope; scope boundary is defined by Tier 2B only. The MSCA-PF scope requirements establish structural and eligibility conditions for fellowships but do not enumerate expected scientific impacts or preferred thematic directions for the research domain.

scope_findings.claim: FIELDWISE advances from the DrR — Digital Agronomist desktop research prototype (an existing asset developed by the researcher prior to the fellowship) through a scientific validation and transferability programme to a web MVP deliverable (drR-digiagro.com), with external evaluation by AgroVIR under commercial farming conditions.
scope_findings.flag_reason: No Tier 2B scope element found to confirm this technology-readiness progression pathway (research prototype to validated web MVP via MSCA fellowship) as in-scope; scope boundary is defined by Tier 2B only. The MSCA-PF scope requirements do not specify expected technology development pathways. This claim cannot be confirmed as in-scope from Tier 2B data alone.
